authorization_reference: User: Launch training. Consecutive in-scope scratch experiments under program.md.
budget_rationale: At most one full GPU contract pass and two disposable changed-width probes. Each probe has 10 warmup, 100 measured and 5 terminal-gap updates plus 24 sampling batches. Twenty minutes includes startup and one memory-driven fallback; unused time grants no extra production training.
selection_rule: Keep S1 microbatch 32 if peak allocation is below 18GB; use 16 only after OOM or failed memory target. Effective batch remains 128. No FID is computed.
production_initialization: New random initialization at update zero after qualification; no qualification weights or optimizer state are saved.
